E1 and E2 state that diffusion governs evolution and that NNK predicts barriers and simulates evolution. E1 and E2 also confirm temperature-dependent ordering and the link between diffusion heterogeneity and B2 formation in NbMoTa. E3 and E4 provide technical details on barrier prediction and the study system, but the core claims are well-supported.
premises: Diffusion governs structural and chemical evolution in compositionally complex materials
Neural network kinetics (NNK) can predict path-dependent migration barriers and individual atom jumps
NNK can simulate diffusion-induced chemical and structural evolution
